newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak Jan-Aug trade gap widens to SKK 35.3 bln.
newsitem.headline: Slovak Jan-Aug trade gap widens to SKK 35.3 bln.

text.p: The Slovak foreign trade deficit for the first eight months of the year widened to 35.306 billion crowns from 31.895 billion for the January-July period and 561 million in January-August 1995, the Slovak Statistical Bureau (SUSR) said on Tuesday.
SLOVAK FOREIGN TRADE Jan-Aug'96 Jan-July'96 Jan-Aug'95
Note. All figures, which are calculated on a custom-cleared basis, are preliminary and subject to revision. The SUSR said it expects to issue final 1995 figures by the end of the third quarter.
